summary_en: Sumitomo Osaka Cement authorized acquisition of up to 3.5 million shares (3.68% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and return profits to shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Sumitomo Osaka Cement's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury stock based on the provisions of the Companies Act Article 156 (as applied by reading Article 165 Paragraph 3). The company will acquire ordinary shares for capital efficiency improvement and shareholder value enhancement.

The acquisition parameters are as follows: up to 3.5 million shares will be purchased, representing 3.68% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026 (when 95,137,842 shares were outstanding excluding 1,066,509 treasury shares). The total acquisition amount will not exceed 5.0 billion yen. Purchases will be executed through open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The acquisition period runs from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027. Any acquired treasury shares without identified future use will be cancelled at an appropriate time. The company notes that share counts reflect a 1-for-3 stock split effective October 1, 2026.
